Legal & Privacy

Privacy Policy

Effective Date: November 1, 2026 • Last Updated: November 1, 2026

1. Introduction

Garage Doors Service Team Queens ("we," "our," or "us") respects your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and protect personal information when you visit our website, submit service inquiries, schedule appointments, or interact with our communication channels in Queens, New York.

2. Information We Collect

We may collect information directly from you when you interact with our website:

  • Contact Information: Full name, telephone number, email address, and physical service address or ZIP code in Queens, NY.
  • Service Inquiry Details: Information regarding your garage door system, symptoms, preferred appointment times, and uploaded photos of garage door hardware.
  • Communications: Records of messages sent via our website forms, live chat, or WhatsApp.
  • Technical Data: Browser type, device characteristics, IP address, and interaction data collected through cookies or basic analytics tools to maintain site security and performance.

3. How We Use Your Information

We use the collected information solely for legitimate business purposes:

  • To evaluate, schedule, and deliver residential garage door services and estimates.
  • To communicate with you regarding service availability, dispatch status, or quotes.
  • To follow up on completed service visits or respond to warranty inquiries.
  • To detect, prevent, and address security incidents or spam submissions.
  • To comply with applicable legal obligations under New York State and federal law.

4. SMS and Telecommunications Policy (TCPA Compliance)

When you provide your phone number and opt in via our website forms, you consent to receive calls and text messages (SMS) from Garage Doors Service Team Queens regarding your service request, appointment confirmations, and estimates. Message and data rates may apply. You may reply STOP at any time to opt out of SMS communications.

5. Third-Party Service Providers

We do not sell, rent, or trade your personal information. We may share information with trusted third-party service providers solely to operate our business:

  • Customer Relationship Management (CRM) and scheduling software (such as GoHighLevel) to manage service records and appointments.
  • Secure cloud web hosting and communication gateways.

6. Data Security and Protection

We implement commercially reasonable administrative, technical, and physical safeguards in accordance with New York State data security guidelines (including the New York SHIELD Act) to protect your personal data from unauthorized access, alteration, or disclosure.

7. Your Rights and Contact Information

You have the right to request access to the personal information we maintain about you, ask for corrections, or request deletion of your records.

To exercise your rights or ask questions regarding this policy, contact our team through our Contact Page.
